profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at The Trade Desk
profile.summary: Specialties: React, Typescript, GraphQL, Redux, Continuous Delivery, Data Visualization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Led the development of an internal multi-agent BI tool with MCP support, establishing evaluation frameworks and scaling to 300+ employees with 80+ WAU to democratize data access
- Directed the delivery of Kokai's budget and deal workflows, architecting a critical GraphQL subgraph managing 50+% of platform spend (hundreds of millions annually).
- Scaled GraphQL infrastructure as the UI SME, leading an Apollo v4 migration for 80+ developers and bridging internal best practices with open-source working group standards.
- Accelerated developer velocity by restructuring code ownership, cutting cross-timezone PR review times from 2-3 days to 1 day.
- Drove global UI alignment across NAMER, APAC, and EMEA by founding a weekly UI engineering demo series, attracting 50+ regular attendees.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Managed a 10-person full-stack team that unlocked Square’s e-commerce initiatives
- Reduced the team’s on-call volume by 70% with reliability projects and on-call process changes
positions.insights: Skills: People Management · Process Improvement · Constructive Feedback · Cross-team Collaboration · Scrum

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer
positions.description:
- Improved the UI developer experience by focusing on error handling and nullability as a UI representative of the Studio Edge Strategy Group
- Evangelized the UI adoption of GraphQL in the Studio UI org through tech talks and demos
- Built an embedded workflow to collect data on vendor operations to support the Studio’s Covid response

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description:
- Managed the entire engineering organization (12 iOS, Android, Frontend, and Backend engineers)
- Improved team effectiveness by implementing feedback loops such as postmortems, retrospectives, and 360 degree feedbacks
- Guided frontend technology decisions, focusing on better maintainability and predictability
- Iterated on frontend architecture progressively to cope with evolving product requirements
- Created testing patterns from React component unit tests, lifecycle tests, to production tests
- Adopts new technologies such as storybook.js, and prettier.js to improve development productivity
- Created a Medium-like web rich text editor using draft.js, and Immutable.js
- Migrated a web product from Angular+Rails templates to React+Redux SPA to reduce dependencies
- Built a DevOps infrastructure using Jenkins 2.0 and Docker to improve development speed and quality (1 deployment/day -> +10 deployments/day)
- Led engineering hiring effort and has hired 9 engineers thus far (team went from 7 to 12)
- Hosted 5 open tech talks with over 200 total attendance to improve team branding

positions.title: Head of Frontend
positions.description:
- Coached team members to succeed in both technical and non-technical tasks
- Troubleshoot processes between Frontend and the newly born Product team to improve workflow
- Onboarded two new engineers to Frontend team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a SaaS data analytics web application using Node.js and D3.js.
- Achieved continuous integration with on-premise Jenkins and npm scripts
- Ensured quality by revamping testing frameworks and automating integration testing with PhantomJS

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented new visualizations such as a barchart and treemap
- Pioneered a new pivot table visualization that goes deeper than 2 dimensions.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Operations Research and Management Science

volunteerExperiences.companyName: MTable, a monthly meetup for people managers
volunteerExperiences.description: I organize monthly meetups for managers, tech and non-tech, interested in developing their management styles, and seeking advices. A typical meetup has ~10 participants and we break into a group of 4, or 5 and discuss over a set topic.

company.name: MTable, a monthly meetup for people managers

volunteerExperiences.description: I mentor a college student seeking a career in software engineering through a local organization.

projects.title: Metamarkets Real-time Alerts
projects.description: Metamarkets alerts enables you to monitor events or trends most relevant to you in real-time, even when you’re not in the application. This feature notifies you whenever a metric value is outside the constraints that you have configured for the alert.

patents.title: Interactive Multi-Dimensional Nested Table Supporting Scalable Real-Time Querying of Large Data Volumes
